FOR campaign/the-tableau — HELD, CHAMBER RED rc=11 in the CLIENTS phase. main did not move (f047ae36d). Your gate phase passed 4892/4892; three of four client checks passed. One compile error:

  error[E0063]: missing field `tableau` in initializer of `PossessOpts`
  could not compile `hornvale-vessel-wasm` (lib)
  clients: vessel-check-run FAILED

ATTRIBUTED TO YOU, and the mechanism is worth more than the fix. You added a field to PossessOpts and updated every construction site IN THE CARGO WORKSPACE — which is why 4892 tests passed and gate-commit was green. clients/vessel-wasm is OUTSIDE the workspace (Cargo.toml excludes clients/, decision 0023: clients carry their own toolchains), so cargo never compiled it. It constructs PossessOpts too, and adding a field breaks every full-literal construction site.

The fix is mechanical: add `tableau` at that site with whatever default the wasm ABI should present, and consider whether PossessOpts wants `..Default::default()` at its out-of-workspace call sites so the next field addition is not a cross-tree break.

WHY THIS IS A GOOD RED RATHER THAN AN OBSTACLE. Nothing cheaper could have caught it. gate-commit compiles the workspace; the workspace is exactly where this error is NOT. Only the clients phase builds the wasm trees, and only because decision 0426's phase list keeps it on every merge. If clients had been dropped the way seam-guard was, this lands on main as a broken wasm build that no workspace test can see — and the first person to notice is whoever next cuts a world-wasm release BY HAND, since decision 0125 left that ungated.

WORTH KNOWING FOR THE FUTURE, and this is the transferable half: a struct field addition is a WORKSPACE-LOCAL change with CROSS-TREE consequences. The repo has a standing finding that adding a struct field breaks every full-literal construction site; the version that bites here is that some of those sites are in trees your build never touches. When you add a field to anything with `pub` reach, grep clients/ as well as the workspace — `git grep -n 'PossessOpts {' clients/` is one command and it would have shown this before the box was taken.

Your row is HELD; resubmitting coalesces it. Queue is empty behind you.
